dataset_spec.name: uci_thoracic
dataset_spec.description: UCI Thoracic Surgery Data (Wroclaw Thoracic Surgery Centre, 2007-2011; 470 patients). Major lung resection for primary lung cancer; 16 preoperative predictors. Binary death within one year of surgery.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult scheduled for major lung resection for primary lung cancer at a thoracic surgery centre (Wroclaw, Poland, 2007-2011). The observations are the preoperative registry record: diagnosis group, spirometry, performance status, symptoms, clinical tumour size, comorbidities, smoking and age.
